SentryBot: [ALERT] Exception ingest delta: project=redwood-inference/hosted-api, drop=96% over last 3m. Suspected upstream auth provider failures (401). See https://sentry.example/issue/123 :warning:

Anna P: Ack — I'm the oncall. Paging infra oncall. @Liam C you're paged as primary, can you take triage? :eyes:

PagerDuty: Incident INC-2026-418 created. Paging Liam C (oncall).

Liam C: Oncall here, looking. First check: hitting our relay DSN returns 401 from auth-provider.example.com. Running quick curl:
```
curl -X POST -H 'X-Sentry-Auth: Sentry sentry_version=7' -d @payload.json https://relay.internal/api/store/ \
  -i
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="auth"
{"error":"token invalid"}
```

Liam C: Logs show repeated 401s starting ~1865431800. Relay uses external token exchange with auth-provider; looks like token endpoint is failing or rejecting our client id.

Maria G: Can we fallback to the static key? We have a fallback long-lived key for the relay but it's gated behind the auth flow currently. If we flip relay auth mode to static we can bypass provider quickly.

Liam C: Agreed. Quick mitigation options: 1) flip RELAY_AUTH_MODE=static and inject SENTRY_RELAY_SECRET (k8s env), 2) enable local buffering in relay so events queue to disk, 3) switch to read-only secondary DSN that uses internal service account. I'm leaning 1 + 2.

Anna P: Prioritize preserving events even if delayed. Alex, please flag priority customers and prepare comms that we're investigating missing error reports; no customer-facing downtime for product, but observability gap exists.

Alex R: On it. Pulling recent SLA-affecting owners: payments, auth, and enterprise-corp. Notifying CS and account reps. Drafting short note: "We're seeing delayed/missing error telemetry; engineering is actively mitigating. We'll update in 30m."

Liam C: Running the env flip in staging first:
```bash
kubectl set env deployment/relay RELAY_AUTH_MODE=static -n prod --dry-run=client -o yaml
# then apply with SENTRY_RELAY_SECRET from vault
```
Applying to prod now with a controlled rollout (1 pod).

SentryBot: [INFO] Relay buffering enabled for project redwood-inference/hosted-api (disk-buffering=true)

Liam C: After flip, relay accepted events locally and started returning 200 to ingesters. Verified by submitting a test event — it landed in relay queue. Still see upstream provider 401s when relay tries to flush downstream.

Maria G: Add policy to keep queue for 24h and retry aggressively (configs updated). Also set alert to reopen if buffered queue length > 10000.

Security Bot: Noting that switching to static auth increases blast radius; ensure secret rotation after provider recovers. Marking incident for security review.

Liam C: Mitigation succeeded at 1865432280: events now accepted by relay and buffered. No new errors in Sentry due to downstream auth still failing, but our buffer retains events for replay.

Anna P: Great. Next steps: 1) monitor buffer drain once auth provider recovers, 2) coordinate with provider (we've opened ticket AUTH-987) to understand root cause, 3) prepare rollback to dynamic auth once safe.

Alex R: CS notified enterprise accounts, added note to status page: "Error reporting degraded for hosted-api — incident under active mitigation; events may be delayed up to 24h."

Liam C: Handing to Maria for long tail and follow-up. I'll stay available for escalation.

Maria G: Taking over post-mitigation. I'll keep the static auth as hotfix until provider confirms stable and we'll rotate keys before switching back. Starting a replay job to ensure buffered events arrive correctly when auth is restored.

Anna P: Handoff noted. Oncall rotation change: I'm off in 30m. Ping if anything regress. :thumbsup:

PagerDuty: Incident INC-2026-418 acknowledged by Liam C; status=mitigated (hotfix applied).

Liam C: Quick note for postmortem: root cause likely token issuer TPS spike leading to request throttling and 401s; we'll need rate-limit backoff and better fallback for token exchange. Add to action items.

Maria G: Adding playbook entry: if auth provider 401s > 50% for 5m, automatically flip to static key and enable buffering, alert security & oncall.

Alex R: Will follow up with customers once we confirm buffered events are delivered.

Anna P: Closing slack thread for oncall handoff. I'll create incident doc in postmortems/ with timeline and customer impact estimates.
